mechanism: A persistent dislocation between spot and perpetual prices, conditioned only on the contemporaneously published perpetual funding rate, may contain a structural convergence/funding-carry component that is measurable without directional price forecasting.

venue_instrument_mapping.substitution_policy: NONE; any unavailable or non-PIT mapping makes this prereg terminally source-ineligible and requires a new prereg rather than substitution.

timestamp_normalization.canonical_timestamp: exchange event timestamp when supplied; otherwise receipt timestamp is not eligible for historical credit
timestamp_normalization.synchronization: use only the latest spot and perpetual observations timestamped at or before the decision clock; maximum cross-leg timestamp skew 5 seconds
timestamp_normalization.late_data: ignored for that decision; no late seal and no retroactive credit

feature_definition.basis: (perpetual_mid / spot_mid) - 1, where each mid=(best_bid+best_ask)/2 from eligible synchronized public quotes
feature_definition.funding: latest officially published funding rate for BTC-USDT-SWAP observable before the decision clock
feature_definition.direction_rule: positive scalar defines short-perpetual/long-spot convergence orientation; negative scalar defines long-perpetual/short-spot orientation; zero gives no directional orientation

causal_clock.decision_clock: exactly 5 minutes before the next officially scheduled funding settlement timestamp
causal_clock.lookback: latest eligible synchronized quote pair and latest funding rate published before that decision clock only
causal_clock.entry: first eligible synchronized quote pair at or after the decision clock and before the settlement; if unavailable, observation is ineligible
causal_clock.exit: first eligible synchronized quote pair at or after the associated funding settlement timestamp, with maximum 60-second delay; otherwise observation is ineligible
causal_clock.holding_semantics: single settlement cycle; no extension, averaging, re-entry or adaptive hold

cost_model.funding_cashflow: use only the officially published rate bound to the preregistered settlement and the frozen orientation; no inferred or revised funding values
cost_model.borrow_or_financing: NOT_CREDITED; if the orientation requires an unavailable borrow or financing leg, the observation is execution-ineligible rather than assigned a favorable synthetic cost

evaluation.collection_start: must be later than the merge/freeze timestamp and source-cost admission timestamp
evaluation.dataset_binding: Before the first economics read, bind an immutable manifest containing source endpoint/version metadata, first/last eligible timestamps, record count and SHA-256 hashes of all raw sealed partitions. Any mismatch fails closed.
